verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents the Zapier Platform CLI/SDK for building third-party integrations and Zapier MCP for AI agent access, but none of it describes a 'Code by Zapier' style step for embedding raw JavaScript/Python logic directly inside a workflow. A hands-on community report explicitly notes frustration at the lack of an option to 'just write some if or 2 lines of code' within a Zap, reinforcing the absence.
